title: The Atlas of Contested Futures — coverage
principles: Public bibliographic metadata only, no full articles.
Credits retain literal source roles. A publishing account is not automatically a person.
Names remain separate across catalogs. Source labels are not verified identities.
Solid edges show source-documented relationships; dashed edges show possible or inferred relationships.
Optional themes use English title keyword matches only; they are not source-assigned subjects.
The graph shows a bounded representative sample; search and the reading room use every loaded record.
Historical deletions, missing bylines, unresolved duplicates and partial archive access remain.
Related catalogs are separately collected, not asserted to be IEET affiliates.

coverage.summary: IEET archives, journals, bibliographies, newsletters, public reports, people and events.
limits: 9,449 legacy article records; 3,467 lack a usable byline. Medium and historical event coverage remain incomplete.
Includes linked publications and pre-IEET predecessor material; inclusion does not establish contemporary institutional affiliation.
Metadata only. Names are source labels, not globally resolved identities; catalogs are not merged by name. Coauthorship, citation and thematic similarity do not establish affiliation.
This compact view omits full text and detailed competing source assertions. Open the evidence links to assess dates, roles and uncertainty.
